cues.text: Outside the dorm, you sit on the front steps with Koromaru sitting at your side. The girl in the floral shirt and the naughty-looking boy run up to him.
The children run off, and the woman who knew Koromaru at the shrine walks up.
The woman has gone. An old man walks up the street toward you.

You and the old man now sit on the dorm steps with a shogi board between you, you leaning forward over it, Koromaru sitting just behind the board and the old man's tote bag beside him. Mitsuru walks up from the street, her school bag in hand.
The game over, the old man walks off down the street, stooped, his bag on his shoulder, leaving you standing at the foot of the steps, hands in your pockets, with Mitsuru and Koromaru.
Koromaru runs off toward the old man's voice, and you follow.
